subject: general
question: As per Census 2011, which of the following states of India has the highest population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **2011 Census**, the most **densely populated state **in **India **is **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• In **2001**, the density of **Uttar Pradesh **was **690 per sq km**, while the **nation's average in 2001 **was **324 per sq km**.
 
• As per the **Aadhar Statistics**, the **Uttar Pradesh population **is **228,959,599 **(**228.96 Million**) as compared to the last census in 2011 is **199,581,477.**
 
• The least **densely populated state **in **India **is **Arunachal Pradesh**. **Total Density: 17**.
 
• **Delhi **is the **densest Union Territory **in **India**. It has a **total density of 11320**.
 
• **Andaman **and **Nicobar Islands **is the **least densely populated UT **in India. **Total Density: 46.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The population density of India is 382. Earlier, in the 2001 Census, the total population density was 324.
 
• Bihar is India's most densely inhabited state (1106 persons/sq km.)
